title: eludite.editor.code_actions input
description: Quick Actions and Refactorings (Ctrl+.): ask the language server for the code actions at `line`, `column` (or the caret), with the diagnostics shown on that line, and open the light bulb menu: fixes first, then refactorings, as Visual Studio groups them. The light bulb in the margin asks the same automatically after the caret rests. A new call cancels the previous request; a result for an older document version or solution generation is dropped.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

line.description: 1-based line of the position; the caret when omitted.

column.description: 1-based column (characters) of the position; 1 when omitted.
